title: WaterSound 10 Compass Point Way

normalized_matching_profile.name: WaterSound 10 Compass Point Way
normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS- Gated Community with on-site Security- 6 Adult Bikes - Gulf views- Elevator- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $35 per day**- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout This property comes with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.LOCATION: This home is 1-2 blocks from the beach. DETAILS: 10 Compass Point Way! This 6 bedroom 7 bath home, in WaterSound is sure to delight. With its massive rooms and rustic surroundings, this will be your perfect vacation retreat. In the kitchen you will experience the high end appliances, granite counter tops, stunning cabinetry and the incredible island. The living room, dining room and kitchen are all included in this open floor plan for everyone to enjoy after a day at the beach. On the first floor, you will find a soothing bedroom with a king size bed. It comes complete with a connecting bathroom with a double vanity and a tub and shower combination. There are 2 queen bedrooms on the first floor, each with a connecting bathroom, single vanity and a glass shower. As you move on to the second floor you will see the bountiful great room, with its comfortable furnishings. The second floor also features a primary bedroom with a king bed that has a connecting bathroom with a double vanity and a glass shower. On this floor, there is also a bedroom with two bunk beds that would be great for the kids! This bedroom also includes a connecting bathroom with a single vanity and a tub and shower combination. The third floor has another spacious primary bedroom with a spa-like connecting bathroom that has a double vanity, large soaker tub and a separate shower. The extraordinary covered patio space, with outdoor seating, and television make for a great gathering spot for everyone to spend time together. There is also an incredible private pool for all to enjoy.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 14):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubAMENITIES INCLUDE: 6 adult bikes provided, elevator access, 2nd living area/den/office. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters laundered upon every checkout. 360 BLUE STAFF & SERVICES: Exclusive Guest Experiences, Concierge Services, Grocery Delivery, Private Chef & More (Extra costs & advanced notice may be required)*Weddings or parties/groups of people or guest of guest are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
